draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Netravali! It's a quiet census town in Sanguem taluka, part of Goa's Kushavati district, and the curiously named Bubbling Lake is just a 15 min walk away.
draft.hungryLine: Netravali is a small place with no real restaurant scene, so carry water and snacks for your wander.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Our Lady Of Pilar Chapel is a 6 min walk, and Bubbling Lake is about 15 min away on foot.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take the 15 min walk out to Bubbling Lake and just sit for a while.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Salaulim Dam in Sanguem taluka took from 1976 to 2000 to build, and its irrigation side reached a potential of 9,537 hectares by 2007.

spots.name: Bubbling Lake
spots.detail: 15 min walk · A lake with a name that makes you want to go and look

spots.name: Our Lady Of Pilar Chapel
spots.detail: 6 min walk · The little chapel close to the centre

spots.name: Salaulim Dam
spots.detail: About 5 km from Sanguem town · A 42.7 m high dam on the Salaulim River

tips.title: Use the forest taxi for Dudhsagar.
tips.body: The only way to reach Dudhsagar Falls is with the Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary taxi near Molem village.

tips.title: Dress modestly at the chapel.
tips.body: Our Lady Of Pilar Chapel is a working place of worship, so cover up a little.

story.title: Ancient temples
story.body: The Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary and Mollem National Park area of Sanguem holds several important temples dating to the Kadamba Dynasty.

story.title: Building Salaulim Dam
story.body: Work on Salaulim Dam, on a tributary of the Zuari River, started in 1976 and finished in 2000. Its water spread covers 24 square km.

story.title: A small forest town
story.body: Netravali is a census town in Sanguem taluka, now in Kushavati district. Sanguem's parkland is also home to the Dhangar, a community of nomadic buffalo herders.
